snippet.title: Perfect Dark VR – Progress Update (First Two Levels Gameplay)
snippet.description:
The dual-wielding system is now functional. You can physically swing the Falcon and the DY357 using motion controls to perform melee attacks, and also throw punches.
I briefly showcase the use of all the weapons in the game. For now, reloading is done using the “B” button for the weapon in the right hand and the “Y” button for the left hand. I’ll try to implement manual reloading, but I’m not sure if I’ll be able to.

Support the project on Ko-fi ❤️ https://ko-fi.com/alexletux
